name: bfe-stateful-ai-stream-integrity
instr:
BFE cannot report AI response lifecycles consistently across forwarding, quota accounting, proxy completion, and operations. Build request-scoped, protocol-aware reporting without changing response bytes, fallback classification, or estimation behavior.

Each `ProtocolAdapter` must create an isolated `StreamObserver`. Finishing publishes one immutable `StreamReport`, even if response or finish callbacks repeat. Later observations return `StreamViolationAfterFinish` without changing it.

OpenAI must reconcile content, finish reasons, cumulative usage-only chunks, and optional terminal markers. Anthropic must enforce message_start, message_delta, and message_stop order while combining staged input and output usage. Gemini must preserve increasing cumulative usage until transport EOF; regressions remain visible in stable snapshots without replacing valid progress.

Observe each decoded SSE event once and forward identical bytes. Keep malformed data forwardable and record `StreamViolationMalformed`. Finalize upstream read failures before callbacks. Treat non-stream bodies as usage and lifecycle evidence under `StreamEndNonStream`, not terminal-looking SSE control.

Use the same evidence for lifecycle and quota accounting. Deduct exact final usage once only when supported; otherwise preserve estimation. Before callbacks, distinguish clean EOF, upstream failure, client cancellation, and non-stream completion. Cancellation must not claim provider completion.

Keep registry fallback
